proof: Positive active counts make four distinct supports identify the region. Decode by x=7-a or 6+a and y=7-b or 6+b. Toward seam at count 1, change region and keep count 1; decoded change is one old unit step. Away increases and inward above 1 decreases. No origin vertex added.
negative_controls: Pair (a,b) without support has four spatial aliases.
Forced +1 on each seam crossing skips one cell.
Raw slot L1 is not native distance.
limits: Two native axes only; square picture is not a metric/angle claim.
Six slots have regional address meanings, not six fixed global E_i components.
No full X6 atlas, Lean, full repository tests or production migration.
